protocol.purpose: Post-outcome diagnostic of immutable v78-v81 issued forecasts. No new model, trading rule, capital replay, case evaluation or deployment qualification.
protocol.main_selection: Immutable v80 recent_ratio top ETF; v81 paired_state accepts a subset. Each comparison evaluates that SAME symbol, never reselects using outcomes or another model.
protocol.identity: N-r = (N-g) + (g-m_y) + (m_y-r). N is v81 current-return regression; g=sum(q*m) is v80 class forecast; m_y is the as-issued v78 mean for realized class y. For executed entries, add label_r-actual_log_return, never silently replace label return.
protocol.category_attribution: With target as reference, g-m_y=sum(k=1..3)[(q_k-I[y=k])*(m_k-m_0)]. This is a samplewise algebraic decomposition, not causal attribution or a probability calibration theorem. Conditional payoff amplitude residual m_y-r also contains sampling noise.
protocol.maturity: Only full original current-contract paired ETF terminal_release strictly before May1 00ET may supply labels, even when an early exit is already visible. Report v81 next-session paired maturity separately. Retain unknown rows and do not score them. This absolute-return audit may have more scoreable dates than v81's waiting comparison.
protocol.weighting: Within each cohort, known rows share one unit per ET date; average date means. Predicted means for ALL rows separately reported. Actual trades are entry-weighted, one entry per date under original ledger. Cohorts and overlapping contracts are not independent evidence.
protocol.visible_states: Descriptive only. Fixed signs of direction-aligned trend5/current give four quadrants; raw industry trend5>0 and relative5>0 define visible positive relative leadership. These pre-outcome features are not proof of money flow, a retrospective hot-market label or a new trading gate. Report all groups, including sparse/empty and unknown groups; do not optimize boundaries.
protocol.comparisons: All five probability sources use the same v80 top symbol and shared v78 class payoff means. Report Brier, log loss with numerical floor1e-8, squared contract-return error, probabilities/frequencies and the exact return decomposition. Scores measure more than calibration alone.
protocol.uncertainty: For candidate mean error terms, 5000 circular10-session block draws seed707 over the full Jan-Apr decision-date grid. Empty cohort dates carry zero numerator and denominator, not fabricated zero returns. Ratio of summed daily numerators to nonempty-date mass; zero-denominator draws remain unknown and are counted. 95% percentile intervals are descriptive for exposed, overlapping and repeatedly studied history.
protocol.provenance: Verify every used source byte against its committed delivery manifest; verify inter-version parent hashes and stored g=sum(q*m). Preserve all old sources/results and unrelated WIP. Raw prices and fitted models remain outside Git.
protocol.acceptance: Original May/July/September arithmetic mean net capital month return>=10%, every May-September month>=0 and complete coverage. This audit cannot authorize case evaluation or mark the goal complete.
